sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000098-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Lakeside Community Health 098 on May 9, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 660 RSV doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
